pieces.name: spine_2story
pieces.notes: 2-story block, N-S crest at x 555 (LiDAR z 26) with a 4 ft flat strip along the top (z 25.8); west face z 23, east face z 21; dark bands from the NW and NE corners are the hips bounding its north face.

pieces.name: cross_2story
pieces.notes: E-W cross on the south half of the 2-story block, ridge at y 420 (LiDAR z 25); its south faces (z 22-23 at y 446) are the lit band at y 400-470 either side of the spine; east hip end z 22 at x 649.

pieces.name: south_band
pieces.notes: 1-story hip wrapped along the south, ridge E-W at y 528 (north face z 14.7 at y 503, south face z 16.8 at y 540), hips to both bottom corners; north eave sits under the 2-story eave at y 475.

pieces.name: nw_flat
pieces.notes: 1-story piece along the west side, LiDAR flat z 11 plan 229 sqft at (427,385) and z 11.4 at (410,475); dark in the image like a membrane roof; NW corner is chamfered by the trace.

notes: 2-story centre (N-S spine with an E-W cross) over a 1-story south hip band and a flat west strip. Confidence MED: the 2-story roof reads as a cross of two hips with a flat crest strip and the fitter may prefer a single pyramid; the south band pitch break at y 475 is read as the 2-story eave meeting a 1-story hip, which matches the LiDAR north-facing face at (435,503).
